title: Constant-space strategy `constspace`
preamble:
# Constant-space strategy `constspace`

The `constspace` strategy capability. A program compiled
`constspace` runs a slab-pool / pre-sized-arena allocator, makes no WCET
claim, requires no `.dsrt` contract, and remains compatible with AOT `CompiledCode`
atoms.

Prefix `LCSP`.

Paired with:

- [LDIA] — the `use` mechanism and
  extension token surface this extends.
- [RTCT] — the stricter sibling. `realtime` ⊃ `constspace` (every
  `realtime` program is also `constspace`).
- [RAOT] — the no-`CompiledCode`-atoms-under-`realtime` gate does **not**
  apply to `constspace`.

## What this is not

- Not a WCET claim. Pump time is unbounded under `constspace`
  alone; the `T_wcet` formula (LDTL.7) does not apply.
- Not a guarantee of zero allocation **ever** — the engine allocates
  pools at boot (engine creation, then pool sizing). The
  guarantee is **no allocation on the hot path** (assert / pump /
  fire).
- Not a replacement for `realtime`. Use `realtime` when WCET
  matters.
- Not a contract carrier — `constspace` programs MUST NOT ship a
  `.dsrt` file (per [LCSP.4.2]).
